unspecified.behavior: A visit-shown pane that the reader hid stays hidden when a queue is started again on the same collection page (Play or a row choice).

scores.reason: show() is skipped while the visit is active, so after hiding the pane on the list and pressing Play the pane remains hidden until the button is pressed.
After hiding the visit-shown pane and pressing Play or a row again on the same collection page, the user sees no queue pane until they press the tree button once.

counted.reason: After hiding the visit-shown pane and pressing Play or a row again on the same collection page, the user sees no queue pane until they press the tree button once.

unspecified.behavior: On a collection page with the tree setting off, opening any file (a grid card or link) starts the visit, and the item pane then stays on the collection list until the page is left.

scores.reason: visitStarted is set by any queuePane && hasFile, so a card click leaves the pane shown on the list afterwards.

With the tree setting off, opening any file of a collection (even from a grid card) shows the item pane, and the list keeps it until the user leaves the page; this is visible but harmless and can be hidden with the button.

counted.reason: With the tree setting off, opening any file of a collection (even from a grid card) shows the item pane, and the list keeps it until the user leaves the page; this is visible but harmless and can be hidden with the button.

unspecified.behavior: Ending a folder queue removes `sort` and `order` even when they were the listing's own URL sort.

scores.reason: After a URL-sorted listing, Play all and ×, the listing falls back to its stored sort.
When a folder queue ends on a listing whose URL already carried its own sort/order, the listing falls back to its default sort and the user must pick the sort again.

counted.reason: When a folder queue ends on a listing whose URL already carried its own sort/order, the listing falls back to its default sort and the user must pick the sort again.

unspecified.behavior: A visit-shown pane the reader hid comes back after the viewport crosses md and returns.

scores.reason: Below md the visit is cleared, and above md show() starts it again with hidden=false.
Resizing or rotating across md brings back a visit pane the user hid; one press hides it again.

counted.reason: Resizing or rotating across md brings back a visit pane the user hid; one press hides it again.

unspecified.behavior: A play intent left pending by a selection that the navigation guard cancelled autoplays the next arrival at that file by any route.

scores.reason: playIntent.ts holds the id until takePlayIntent matches it.
A cancelled queue selection leaves the module-level pending id (playIntent.ts:6-10), so a later arrival at that same file by any route starts playing even with Autoplay off.

counted.reason: A cancelled queue selection leaves the module-level pending id (playIntent.ts:6-10), so a later arrival at that same file by any route starts playing even with Autoplay off.
